protection_paladin_exposure_evidence.cause: Righteous Defense is consumed on a different party member immediately before GUIDs 61 and 62 switch to the healer. The Protection Paladin density resolver then selects the native ranged Hand of Reckoning spell 62124, but the generic profile movement envelope makes the tank spend four recorded density decisions approaching the remote target. Salvation consumes the first in-range decision, and Hand of Reckoning is not submitted until 4024 ms after the two-hostile healer episode begins. The adjacent hostile therefore remains on the healer past both strict exposure and dwell gates even though overall tank retention passes.

Canary 3 completed all 14 route terminals and all four boss kills under the exact planned identity and party, but its strict Protection Paladin role audit failed closed.

The serial operator correctly stopped after canary 3; canaries 4 through 8 and Phases 10 through 12 remain blocked.
